title: AMD (AMD) Buys Taalas: Is AI Inference the Next Battleground With Nvidia?
excerpt: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) just announced an acquisition that could give major competition to NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) in AI-inference...
content_html:
Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) just announced an acquisition that could give major competition to NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) in AI-inference. On August 6, AMD said it has agreed to buy chip startup Taalas as specialized inference chips become a critical area of focus for semiconductor makers. The financial terms of the deal have not been disclosed.

The company plans to integrate Taalas' technology into its accelerator roadmap and develop system-level solutions combining it with AMD Instinct graphics processing units (GPUs).

"AMD is building a full-stack AI platform that gives customers ‌the ⁠flexibility to deploy the right compute solutions for every AI workload," Vamsi Boppana, senior vice president of AMD's Artificial Intelligence Group, said in a statement.

AMD Expands its AI Inference Arsenal

The acquisition strengthens AMD's AI portfolio by offering it differentiated inference performance and efficiency. The move also highlights the rising importance for leading GPU makers to offer integrated systems with several different components and chips rather than standalone processors.

The acquisition itself follows a string of smaller inference-focused deals made by AMD. Back in November, the company acquired MK1, an AI software startup ⁠specializing in high-speed inference. It also acquired MEXT in June and added FastFlowLM to its artificial intelligence group in July. Together, these moves may strengthen AMD's AI inference capabilities to compete with giants such as Nvidia.

Taalas's technology could also offer AMD both speed and lower costs. The company says that the HC1 demonstrator reportedly delivers around 17,000 tokens per second per user when running Llama 3.1 8B. It also claims that its systems can cost 20 times less to build and use 10 times less power because they avoid HBM, advanced packaging, and liquid cooling.

AI Inference to Become the Next Nvidia Battleground

AMD's latest buying spree follows merely months after NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) struck a $20 billion deal with Groq, a designer of high-performance AI chips, for its inference technology and talent. Nvidia chips have dominated the process of AI model training for quite some time, but its graphics processors face greater competition from central processing units and custom processors.

Inference computing, the process of answering queries, occurs every time AI models are used. As AI assistants, coding agents, and similar applications handle billions of queries, factors such as latency, throughput, and power efficiency become increasingly important.

content_html_zh:
Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：AMD）刚刚宣布了一项收购，这可能会给 NVIDIA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）带来人工智能推理领域的重大竞争。 8 月 6 日，AMD 表示，随着专业推理芯片成为半导体制造商关注的关键领域，AMD 已同意收购芯片初创公司 Taalas。 该交易的财务条款尚未披露。

该公司计划将 Taalas 的技术整合到其加速器路线图中，并开发将其与 AMD Instinct 图形处理单元 (GPU) 相结合的系统级解决方案。

AMD 人工智能集团高级副总裁 Vamsi Boppana 在一份声明中表示：“AMD 正在构建一个全栈人工智能平台，让客户能够灵活地为每个人工智能工作负载部署正确的计算解决方案。”

AMD 扩大其人工智能推理武器库

此次收购通过为其提供差异化​​的推理性能和效率，增强了 AMD 的人工智能产品组合。 此举还突显了领先 GPU 制造商提供具有多种不同组件和芯片的集成系统（而不是独立处理器）的重要性日益增加。

此次收购本身是在 AMD 进行的一系列较小的以推理为重点的交易之后进行的。 早在 11 月，该公司就收购了 MK1，这是一家专门从事高速推理的人工智能软件初创公司。 它还于 6 月收购了 MEXT，并于 7 月将 FastFlowLM 添加到其人工智能部门。 总之，这些举措可能会增强 AMD 的人工智能推理能力，以与 Nvidia 等巨头竞争。

Taalas 的技术还可以为 AMD 提供速度和更低的成本。 该公司表示，据报道，HC1 演示程序在运行 Llama 3.1 8B 时每秒为每个用户提供约 17,000 个代币。 它还声称，由于避免了 HBM、先进封装和液体冷却，其系统的构建成本可以降低 20 倍，能耗也可以降低 10 倍。

AI 推理将成为 Nvidia 的下一个战场

AMD 最新一轮收购热潮发生在 NVIDIA 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）与高性能 AI 芯片设计商 Groq 达成 200 亿美元交易，以获取其推理技术和人才的几个月后。 Nvidia 芯片在相当长一段时间内主导了 AI 模型训练过程，但其图形处理器面临来自中央处理器和定制处理器的更大竞争。

每次使用人工智能模型时都会发生推理计算，即回答查询的过程。 随着人工智能助手、编码代理和类似应用程序处理数十亿次查询，延迟、吞吐量和功效等因素变得越来越重要。
